scope: All 137 tradeable Jewelcrafting jewelry, equipment, component, setting, utility, weapon, and sealed random-result outputs

rules.external_role: Gold-normalized relative rank within comparable BoE or like-purpose craft cohorts only.
rules.gold_scale: Fixed frozen Hellscream cohort anchors or qualified completed sales.
rules.reagent_floor_role: Exact audited 3.3.5 recipe cost is a separate craftability diagnostic and does not automatically set market value.
rules.random_result_rule: Icy Prism, Brilliant Glass, and Prismatic Black Diamond are valued only as sealed finished items; possible contents never inherit the full input cost.
rules.sparse_sale_rule: Low-confidence completed sales receive 25% weight, or 50% when they span at least two buyers and two UTC days; the balance remains the reviewed cohort fallback.
rules.single_item_medium_gate: At least four completed buyouts, two distinct buyers, and two distinct UTC days, with largest-buyer unit share at most 0.50.
rules.stackable_medium_gate: The single-item gate plus at least 12 completed units.
rules.no_coverage_rule: Without completed sales or external comparison coverage, retain the frozen pre-Phase-2 band.
rules.large_change_rule: A fallback or sparse-sale Target move over 50% requires at least two comparison realms; qualified local completed sales may stand independently.
